data.name: Eve
data.message: Just finished sorting cargo, you doing a task here too?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Finishing cameras, then I’m heading weapons/nav.

data.name: Frank
data.message: Finishing cargo, then I’m heading medbay.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Heading to electrical for distributor, then medbay.

I found Frank’s body in storage. My route was cafeteria -> medbay -> storage for my task. I hadn’t seen anyone before that, but when I got to storage, Eve was right there next to the body with me. I reported immediately. Eve should explain what happened there.

I started in oxygen, went through upper engine, then to medbay. I didn’t encounter anyone at all this round, and I never went into storage or saw Frank. I was in medbay when the report happened.

Since Diana found the body in storage and says Eve was right there, Eve definitely needs to explain her route and why she was next to the body. I can’t confirm anything else from my side.

I started in electrical and went to security. I was in security for most of the round with Charlie there — I saw Charlie enter security from navigation around tick 3, stay there ticks 4 and 5, then leave security toward electrical at tick 6.

I never went to storage and I didn’t see Frank at all. From what I saw, Charlie was on the right side with me, so I don’t think Charlie was near storage unless there’s a timing I’m missing. Diana reporting storage with Eve right there is the main thing we need explained. Eve should give exact route and timing.

I was on the right side the whole round. I started in navigation, then went up to security for my task. Alice came into security from electrical around tick 3, and I saw her in security with me ticks 4, 5, and 6. I didn’t see Frank at all, and I never went near storage.

So I can pretty strongly clear Alice for this kill, and Alice can clear me from being in storage. Bob says he was medbay, which is close to storage but I can’t confirm it. Diana reporting in storage with Eve allegedly right next to the body is the biggest info so far.

I want to hear Eve’s exact route and whether she saw Frank alive, because right now Eve has the most explaining to do.

I get why I'm the focus — Diana walked in on me next to Frank's body and that looks bad. So let me be clear about my route.

I started in storage and stayed there the entire round doing the sort cargo task. Frank came in from lower engine at tick 3 — I saw him enter. We were both in storage ticks 3, 4, and 5 working. I didn't see anyone kill him, which means whoever did it came in and out fast, OR — and I want to be honest here — I was heads-down on the task and missed it.

Here's the thing though: if I killed Frank, why would I still be standing right next to the body when Diana walked in? I'd have left. I had every chance to leave storage before someone arrived and I didn't, because I had nothing to hide.

Diana came in from medbay at the report tick. Bob also claims medbay. One of them could have slipped into storage briefly — storage connects to medbay (2 ticks). Alice and Charlie seem to alibi each other on the right side, so I'd look hardest at Bob's medbay claim, since medbay is the closest unaccounted room to storage.

I know I look suspicious from Diana's POV. But I'm telling the truth.

I want to push back on Eve’s explanation. I came cafeteria -> medbay -> storage, and when I entered storage Frank was already dead with Eve standing right there next to the body. I reported immediately.

I did not see anyone running out of storage, and I did not see Bob in storage. Eve says she was in storage the entire round with Frank, so if someone else came in and killed him, she should have seen them enter or leave. And if she was innocent and saw the body, why didn’t she report before I walked in?

Alice and Charlie sound mutually alibied on the right side. Bob’s medbay claim is close, but Eve’s story doesn’t really make sense because she was in the room the whole time. I think Eve is the strongest vote here.

My info hasn’t changed: I was in medbay at the report and I did not see anyone there, including Diana, so she must have passed through before or after my vision/timing.

Eve’s explanation is the problem for me. She says she was in storage the whole round, Frank came in, and then somehow Frank died in the same room without her seeing who did it or reporting the body. If another person came into storage to kill, Eve should have seen them enter or leave. And if she noticed the body, she should have reported before Diana arrived.

I understand Eve pointing at me because medbay is close, but I never went into storage and nobody has placed me there. Diana physically found Eve next to Frank’s body. Alice and Charlie seem to cover each other on the right side. So from the information we have, I think Eve is the strongest vote.

My info is still the same: I was electrical -> security, and I was with Charlie on the right side for most of the round. I saw Charlie come in from navigation at tick 3, stay in security with me through ticks 4 and 5, then leave toward electrical at tick 6. I never went near storage and never saw Frank.

Based on everyone’s stories, Alice/Charlie are pretty clear for this kill from our mutual timing. Bob is technically near storage in medbay, but nobody actually places him in storage. The big issue is Eve saying she was in storage the whole round with Frank, Frank died there, and she neither saw who did it nor reported the body before Diana arrived.

If Eve was innocent and in the room, she should have either seen the killer come in/out or reported Frank. Diana finding Eve next to the body matches Eve being the killer much more than Bob somehow slipping in unseen. I’m voting Eve unless something major changes.

My info stays the same: I was navigation -> security, and Alice was with me in security from tick 4 through tick 6. I never went anywhere near storage and never saw Frank, so I’m clearing Alice for this kill and she clears me.

Looking at the storage situation, Eve’s story is the only one that really doesn’t add up. She says she was in storage the whole time, Frank came in, then Frank died in the same room, but she didn’t see a killer and also didn’t report the body. If Bob or Diana came in to kill, Eve should’ve seen them enter or leave. And Diana is the one who reported immediately after finding Eve standing by the body.

Bob being in medbay is close, but no one places him in storage. Diana’s report lines up with Eve being caught at the body. I think Eve is by far the strongest vote here.

I hear all of you, and I know the math looks bad for me. But think about this carefully before you lock in a vote.

Diana's whole case rests on "Eve was next to the body." Yes — because I was in storage the entire round doing sort cargo. Frank walked in at tick 3 from lower engine. If I had killed him the moment he walked in, I had four ticks to leave storage before Diana arrived. I didn't. I stayed. That's not how a killer behaves.

Now consider Diana's route: cafeteria -> medbay -> storage. Medbay to storage is 2 ticks. She arrives, Frank is dead, and she immediately points at me and calls the meeting. That's also exactly what a killer who wants a free scapegoat would do — kill Frank, then "report" with the only other person in the room as the obvious suspect.

As for Bob — medbay is the adjacent room, and he conveniently says he saw no one there, including Diana, even though Diana claims she passed through medbay. That's a contradiction. One of them is lying about medbay.

I can't prove I didn't do it. But Diana and Bob's stories don't line up with each other, and only one of them was actually in storage with the body. I'd rather we vote Diana or at least skip than auto-eject the person caught in the obvious frame.
